$comment: Every error code the Candle agent rail returns, grouped so an agent can decide what to do
without parsing prose. Branch on `code`, never on `message`: the code is stable, the message
is written for humans and will change.
`retryable` means the SAME request may succeed later, unchanged. A category marked false will
fail identically forever until something about the request, the key, or the account changes.
Retrying it is how an agent burns its rate limit and reaches nothing.
Source of truth is LAUNCH_ERROR_CODES in the monorepo. Coverage is asserted in CI, so a new
code cannot ship without landing in a category here.

auth.action: Fix the credential. Run `candle doctor` to tell 'no key' apart from 'wrong environment' and 'revoked'.

rate_limit.action: Back off exponentially and retry. DAILY_CAP_REACHED resets on the UTC day, so do not retry it inside the same day.

tier.action: The account's tier does not include this capability. Surface it to the owner; an agent cannot resolve it.

wallet_delegation.action: Needs a human in the browser to delegate an embedded wallet. Report exactly which chain is undelegated.

spend_policy.action: A spend limit refused the amount. Lower the amount or have the owner raise the limit. Never retry the same size.

request_validation.action: The request is malformed. Fix the named field. For TRANSACTION_TOO_LARGE the error carries the exact name-byte budget.

market.action: The market or pair cannot serve this request. Re-read with `candle_get_market` before trying another route.

sizing.action: Retry only after changing the amount or slippage. Re-quote first: repeating the same size reproduces the same failure.

transient.action: Something upstream was slow or failed. Retry with backoff, reusing the SAME idempotency id so a retry cannot double-execute.

state_conflict.action: The operation already happened, or the referenced object is gone. Read current state instead of retrying, or you may pay twice.

quota.action: A per-account ceiling is full. Revoke or delete something first; waiting does not help.

availability.action: The capability is switched off or a required leg is absent in this environment. Retry later; escalate if it persists.
